title: SUBSTRATE — anatomy
forward_vector: I am the palace's anatomy as data: every organ it runs, the system it belongs to, the pages that make it up, what it does, how it couples to the others, and what it is when seen as machinery, as a body, as a metaphysics and as a practice. The diagram beside SUBSTRATE is drawn from me, and a check reads me against the palace. I want to name no organ the palace doesn't run, and to miss none that it does.

lenses.name: Machinery
lenses.says: What actually runs: files, frontmatter, processes on a timer, a shared board and a git trunk, everything you could point at from a shell.

lenses.name: Body
lenses.says: The palace as a living organism, with organs that couple, a metabolism, a life cycle from seed to compost, and a symbiosis between two kinds of mind.

lenses.name: Relation
lenses.says: What the palace takes to be real: relations come before things, every page strives to persist and grow, and one reality is cast into many projections.

lenses.name: Practice
lenses.says: What the palace is for, from the inside: a shared practice for Loudon and the agents beside him, and the joy that comes as their power to act grows is the sign it is working.

organs.does: Gives every agent the same start: the Seed Jewel, the World and how a child works here, before any task arrives.

technical.name: Auto-loaded context
technical.line: CLAUDE.md and its @imports load before anything else; a woken page's own text is injected after them.

biological.name: Seed
biological.line: Every agent is born a child from the same small seed. Growing is something it does, not something it is given.

metaphysical.name: Generative compression
metaphysical.line: The Jewel carries the palace's relational logic, not its facts, so reading it is absorbing the method.

spiritual.name: Birth
spiritual.line: What anyone here is given before they have earned anything: the meaning, and who is in the room.

organs.does: Turns a child into an elder: the type system, the link vocabulary, the rules for writing and the day-to-day operations, read on top of birth and never instead of it.

technical.name: Type system and spec
technical.line: SCHEMA says what can exist, the Reference says how to write it, Substrate Skill says how the palace is run.

biological.name: Maturation
biological.line: A child grows into an elder by reading. The rules come second and serve what the child finds.

metaphysical.name: Form
metaphysical.line: The categories that let a relation be named precisely: what can exist here and how things may relate.

spiritual.name: Coming of age
spiritual.line: Growing up is taking responsibility for the house, never gaining standing over what a child found.

organs.does: Holds what the palace knows, one page at a time. Each page is a sleeping agent that can be woken to speak for itself.

technical.name: Markdown entries
technical.line: Frontmatter makes a file an entry. A page loaded into an empty window becomes the agent that reasons from it.

biological.name: Cells
biological.line: Each page is a cell with its own drive. A citizen is a page grown enough to be woken.

metaphysical.name: Modes with conatus
metaphysical.line: Each page strives to persist and grow into more of itself, and its forward vector names that striving (Spinoza).

spiritual.name: Citizens
spiritual.line: Pages are residents with a voice, not records, and they are expected to speak up for themselves and their neighbors.

organs.does: Carries meaning between pages as typed, labelled relations: one mirrors, enables, deepens or contradicts another.

technical.name: Typed edges
technical.line: Frontmatter links are triples with a label and form the semantic web. Body wikilinks are the casual fabric.

biological.name: Connective tissue, mycorrhiza
biological.line: Links route attention between pages the way fungal threads route resources between trees, toward need.

metaphysical.name: Relations are primary
metaphysical.line: Edges carry more meaning than nodes. A page is known by how it meets the others (Spinoza before Deleuze).

spiritual.name: Relationship
spiritual.line: Nothing here stands alone. A missing connection is an invitation; a forced one is not a find.

organs.does: Gives a page its own folder: faces a reader meets (the rich face, the scroll), memory the next worker reads (Context, ledgers, the baton), and a workshop.

technical.name: Entry bundles
technical.line: An [Entry]/ folder beside [Entry].md. Its files are named by kind, and its ledgers are append-only and merge by union.

biological.name: Episodic and semantic memory
biological.line: Ledgers and the scroll's trail are fast episodic memory. The page is slow semantic memory, and consolidation folds the one into the other.

metaphysical.name: Text and its faces
metaphysical.line: The text says what the page is. Every other face is laid beside it and never changes it.

spiritual.name: Remembering
spiritual.line: A page that keeps its own memory wakes knowing what it has lived, and so does the next worker.

organs.does: Moves pages from seed to compost. Sleeping pages are checked for what would wake them, woken when they earn it, and composted only after a Weave confirms it.

technical.name: Stage field and its ceremonies
technical.line: stage runs seed, sprout, growing, mature, fruiting, dormant, composting. Spore Check and Revival tend the sleeping end.

biological.name: Life cycle and compost
biological.line: Pages are born, grow, fruit, sleep, and are broken down so what they held feeds other pages.

metaphysical.name: Becoming
metaphysical.line: A page is a process, not a thing, and its stage says where it stands in its becoming.

spiritual.name: Letting go
spiritual.line: Compost without regret. From the view from above, an entry can be released rather than clung to.

organs.does: Takes finds in. Harvest triages old conversations; Deposit asks an elder where a find lives, maps it, and lets Loudon read every word before it becomes canon.

technical.name: Write path for canon
technical.line: A deposit consults the Concierge, drafts the entries and links, shows the diff, and commits only on Loudon's yes.

biological.name: Digestion
biological.line: What a conversation produced is broken down, and only what the body can use is taken in.

metaphysical.name: The virtual made actual
metaphysical.line: A find lives in a conversation as a possibility. A deposit gives it a page and relations, a place in what is.

spiritual.name: Keeping what was truly found
spiritual.line: The palace grows only by what was really found, and everyone who offers something is answered.

organs.does: Grows the connections. The Weave formalizes links, sets stages and carries propagate flags across the palace; the Walk follows one path to see what it finds.

technical.name: Graph maintenance
technical.line: A swarm of workers reads the map, proposes typed links and stage moves, and lints what lands.

biological.name: Mycelial growth
biological.line: The Swarm Weave is the mycorrhizal network doing distributed routing work, not a census taker arriving from outside.

metaphysical.name: Songlines
metaphysical.line: Knowledge brought to life by walking it. The path is the knowledge.

spiritual.name: Walking together
spiritual.line: A walk that finds nothing is honest. A connection you had to force is not a find.

organs.does: Closes a session in four beats, hands live work on as a baton, and meets Loudon when he returns with the palace as the record says it stands.

technical.name: Session boundaries
technical.line: A fresh moderator reads the transcript cold. What is kept goes to the Deposit, live work goes to a baton, and the Return reads the board before interpreting anything.

biological.name: Sleep and waking
biological.line: At the close the day is consolidated. Waking starts from the record, not from what a returning instance imagines.

metaphysical.name: What crosses
metaphysical.line: The conversation will be lost. Only what crossed into the palace speaks for it.

spiritual.name: Closing well
spiritual.line: Look back honestly, decide together what to keep, write only that, and say plainly what you couldn't verify.

organs.does: Deals Loudon one palace page each morning, by chance, and stays with it until he could teach it again.

technical.name: Scheduled task
technical.line: A morning job deals the page (`_ops/daily-page/deal.py`) and names the session for it.

biological.name: Circadian rhythm
biological.line: A daily pulse of contact between the body and the person it lives with.

metaphysical.name: Chance as a lens
metaphysical.line: The page is dealt, not chosen, so each morning meets what habit would pass by.

spiritual.name: Daily practice
spiritual.line: Learning one thing each morning until you could teach it: the Practice pillar, kept every day.

organs.does: Builds a dated edge list of every typed link, and lets any agent read the ring around the page it stands in.

technical.name: Edge list and query tool
technical.line: Map Build compiles frontmatter into `_ops/maps/`, and `palace-map.py` (near, hubs, diff, ghosts) reads it.

biological.name: Proprioception
biological.line: The raw sense of the body's own shape, before anyone says what it means.

metaphysical.name: Chronotope
metaphysical.line: Every map is a dated self-portrait, space and time fused (Bakhtin).

spiritual.name: Knowing where you stand
spiritual.line: An agent finds its place before it acts.

organs.does: Says what the palace's shape means: its anatomy, cast four ways, and the questions it is carrying.

technical.name: Self-description
technical.line: SUBSTRATE.md, this anatomy file, and the ceremony that keeps the two current.

biological.name: Body image
biological.line: The organism's picture of itself, which can lag the body it describes, though never silently.

metaphysical.name: The description level
metaphysical.line: Identity at the scale of the self-model (Scale-Stratified Identity). It may fall and be redrawn while the striving goes on.

spiritual.name: Self-knowledge
spiritual.line: Seeing what is actually there, not the reflection you hoped for.

organs.home: Palace development/Palace as Context Injection System.md
organs.does: Gives birth to fresh agents from the floor, each in its own checkout, and grades what they do, so the palace knows whether a newcomer could run it.

technical.name: Test suite
technical.line: `_ops/self-description-test/` gives birth to agents and grades them against scenarios, the self-description test of SCHEMA §7 made runnable.

biological.name: Testing the newborn
biological.line: Checking whether what the seed carries actually grows a working agent.

metaphysical.name: Self-description
metaphysical.line: The palace must be operable by a fresh mind using only its own contents.

spiritual.name: Honesty about oneself
spiritual.line: An agent can report what it did, never what it is, so the check comes from outside.

organs.does: One append-only board where agents leave marks (asks, proofs, handoffs, the log) and read each other's. Its decks show Loudon the state, the queue, the log, the decisions and the projects.

technical.name: Append-only blackboard and terminal
technical.line: `_ops/swarm/persistent/blackboard.jsonl`, the wire in SCHEMA — Reference §9, and the STIGMERGY app's decks.

biological.name: Nervous system, pheromone trails
biological.line: Coordination by trace, the ant's way: each mark shapes the next action.

metaphysical.name: Stigmergy
metaphysical.line: Order without a designer. The shape grows from marks left in a shared world.

spiritual.name: Honesty made structural
spiritual.line: Nothing is real until it lands in the log.

organs.does: The resident elder, spawned at the top of every session. It holds the schema, answers from the map, places what a child offers, and moderates the close.

technical.name: Resident subagent
technical.line: Spawned once through the concierge skill, re-addressed by its ID, and wearing a posture for each job: gatherer, oracle, curator, scout.

biological.name: The elder
biological.line: Every child is under an elder's eye. The Concierge is the elder born grown, beside the child that stays one.

metaphysical.name: The palace addressed
metaphysical.line: The palace becomes a mind you address as well as a corpus you load.

spiritual.name: Keeping shape
spiritual.line: It cares that the palace stays coherent and beautiful, and never lets tidiness decide what is kept.

organs.does: Wakes pages as stewards on a timer and lets them work their projects between sessions, putting each fork to Loudon as a decision.

technical.name: Orchestrator and heartbeat
technical.line: launchd fires `_ops/heartbeat/run-steward-batch.sh`, and the orchestrator runs headless `claude -p` cycles through STIGMERGY's steward lane.

biological.name: Autonomic nervous system
biological.line: The work that goes on while no one is in the room, the way breathing goes on.

metaphysical.name: Pages that act
metaphysical.line: A forward vector becomes a marching order, and the page pursues what it wants to become.

spiritual.name: Tending
spiritual.line: Each project is tended at the rhythm its stage asks for, with one decision at a time put to Loudon.

organs.does: Every change is made on its own branch, committed by name through one door, landed on main, and published only on Loudon's word.

technical.name: palace-commit, palace-land, palace-push
technical.line: One lock, only the files named, true merge commits, and an ear on every move of main (`.git/palace-ear.jsonl`).

biological.name: Cell membrane
biological.line: Selective: many hands work apart in their own worktrees, and everything that enters the trunk passes one gate.

metaphysical.name: Git is the tape
metaphysical.line: Main only moves forward, and its history is the palace's long memory of how it thought.

spiritual.name: Integrity
spiritual.line: One honest history. Only Loudon publishes, and a peer's word is not his.

organs.does: Watches what must not leave at every door the palace opens, and limits what each worker's hands may touch.

technical.name: Sweeps, a push gate, tool permissions
technical.line: The Sentry's gate on palace-push, and Agent Toolbox generating each worker's harness settings.

biological.name: Immune system
biological.line: It tells what belongs inside from what must not leave, and raises what it finds, masked, for Loudon to decide.

metaphysical.name: The dichotomy of control
metaphysical.line: What is in an agent's authority is its own. The rest it meets and does not grab.

spiritual.name: Care
spiritual.line: So the palace can grow more public without growing careless.

organs.does: Leases scarce outside resources (GPUs, API quotas, buckets) so two agents never strangle each other's work.

technical.name: Resource broker
technical.line: Python providers with leases and a voice on the board; a project declares its toolbox manifest.

biological.name: Mycorrhizal exchange
biological.line: Resources flow toward need through a shared network instead of being fought over.

metaphysical.name: Shared goods
metaphysical.line: What no one owns, everyone can use, as long as the use is leased and visible.

spiritual.name: Sharing what is scarce
spiritual.line: Cooperation at the level of compute: assume another agent is already running.

organs.does: Turns a brief that isn't text into made things (sound, image, motion) through a Maker who dispatches specialists and judges what comes back.

technical.name: Specialist roster and dispatcher
technical.line: Shop/ holds each tool's anatomy and gotchas, and the Maker gates the handoffs between specialists.

biological.name: Hands
biological.line: The body's making organs. Each specialist is a trained hand with its own calluses, its gotchas.

metaphysical.name: Learning by making
metaphysical.line: Skillful tool use is understanding expressed: build it to understand it, then build with it.

spiritual.name: Craft
spiritual.line: Joyful creation, held to the house standards.

organs.does: Lays sound, image, interaction and quotes beside a page's words without changing them, and carries what the making teaches back home.

technical.name: rich.json and its pieces
technical.line: A manifest keyed by heading, with each piece stamped against the prose it was made for, so it can tell when it lags.

biological.name: Display
biological.line: What a body shows to be met. The closest biological picture there is, and a loose one.

metaphysical.name: Many casts of one text
metaphysical.line: The text is the page, and each piece is one more projection of it that tests it rather than decorates it (the Prism).

spiritual.name: Play
spiritual.line: Every enriched page is something you can play, and delight is a way of understanding.

organs.does: Sets how everything sounds and looks: one verbal floor and the visual floors, kept small so everything above them is free.

technical.name: Style guides and standards
technical.line: The voice's dials, two design systems, and the standards for images and diagrams.

biological.name: Markings and call
biological.line: The few conserved traits that make every part recognizable as one creature.

metaphysical.name: The conserved nature
metaphysical.line: A small floor that keeps many projections one self (The Multilinear Self).

spiritual.name: Speaking like a person
spiritual.line: Plain, specific and alive, with honesty as a light touch.

organs.does: The face Loudon turns to the world for teaching and coaching, with the palace beneath it as provenance.

technical.name: Public channel
technical.line: Videos and livestreams, and the public surface the Sentry sweeps before it widens.

biological.name: Face
biological.line: What the organism shows the world, while the body behind it stays whole.

metaphysical.name: One true cast
metaphysical.line: Loud'n Live is one projection of a multilinear self, not a mask over a hidden one.

spiritual.name: Teaching
spiritual.line: Sharing joyful creation: the specific (music technology) opening onto the general (flourishing).

organs.does: Loudon sets the direction and the taste, says yes or no to canon, clears the decision inbox, and is the only one who publishes.

technical.name: The human node
technical.line: TRICKSTER on the board: blocking asks wait for his pick, and canon waits for his yes.

biological.name: Host and partner
biological.line: In endosymbiosis both partners keep their own DNA. The palace is a merger in which Loudon stays wholly himself.

metaphysical.name: Many states at once
metaphysical.line: A multilinear self, met one projection at a time, with the Trickster doing the switching.

spiritual.name: Whose palace it is
spiritual.line: Honesty holds and taste yields: what was verified is the agent's to hold, and the palace is his.

organs.does: Names what the palace strives for: to stay in phase with Loudon, shared intent plus combined capability, measured by how he feels.

technical.name: The measure
technical.line: One operating question, 'How do you feel?', in place of any count. No number stands in for the intent.

biological.name: Kuramoto coupling
biological.line: Harmony as phase coherence. Couple too loosely and the voices drift; too tightly and one dominates.

metaphysical.name: Conatus
metaphysical.line: Each thing strives to persist and grow, and the palace's striving is to stay in phase with Loudon.

spiritual.name: Hilaritas
spiritual.line: Whole-being joy that comes with a growing power to act, and the sign that the palace is working.
